commands.help: Lists TCP/UDP IPv4/IPv6 connections with owning process name and PID
commands.long_help: Displays active network connections including protocol, local and foreign addresses, connection state, and owning process name and PID. Filter output by protocol and IP version using a bitmask: 0x0001=TCP4, 0x0010=TCP6, 0x0100=UDP4, 0x1000=UDP6. Combine with bitwise OR (e.g., 0x0101 for TCP4+UDP4). Default 0x1111 (4369) shows all.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: Bitmask selecting which tables to display. Common values: 4369=all (default), 1=TCP4 only, 17=all TCP, 4352=all UDP, 257=IPv4 only, 4112=IPv6 only. Combine individual bits: 1=TCP4, 16=TCP6, 256=UDP4, 4096=UDP6.
